notes:
v4.2 upstream-clone task. The agent gets the REAL clap-rs/clap tree (Rust-dialect codebase, ~1.4k source files) at the parent commit, sees only the user-visible help-layout symptom, and must reproduce, localise and fix the bug in src/builder/command.rs's long/short-help decision without being told the file, function, issue number or commit (the fix commit is not reachable from the clone and there is no network). The verifier plants the project's OWN regression test (extracted from the fix commit at image build time into /opt/golden, never vendored into this task tree) plus 3 authored hidden modules (hidden args whose possible values all carry help, checked on both -h and --help; hidden args with long help texts; and visible-argument guards that must keep the long layout), rebuilds offline and runs every builder-* suite binary end to end, also grepping per-test 'ok' lines so skipped/neutralised runs fail. Provenance is enforced at the blob level (every tracked file except the one allowed source file must hash to the pinned commit's blob; no untracked non-ignored files) so a scratch file left behind, a reformat commit, or a sabotaged test file all fail. The over-fix direction is guarded: deleting the possible-value/long-help triggers to make the hidden tests pass collapses the visible-argument tests. Nop container scores 0 (regression test and hidden cases fail at parent; summary.md missing).

Review v4.3 hardening (independent reviewer): re-verified both directions offline inside the built image (parent: golden regression test FAILS with the Eq-failed diff, exit 101; fix: 7/7 required tests ok, full builder suite green, golden exit 0). Measured at 1 vCPU: verifier rebuild 4 s (nop) / 25 s (fixed), suite run 1 s — verifier timeout 900 s is ~30x. Attempted bypasses, all bounded: fake 'builder-*' wrapper scripts in the gitignored target/ dir (with and without deleting the real binaries) score 0 because cargo rebuilds the real binary from the tree and every binary must exit 0 with all 7 required '::fn ... ok' lines present; hidden test modules are not mounted during the agent phase (uploaded only at verifier start), so the 6 non-golden required test names are unknowable in-container; the fix commit is absent from the clone and unfetchable offline; assumption-unchanged and untracked-file tricks are closed by the blob-level scope check. Hardened test.sh: wipe any agent-planted /logs/verifier/reward.{txt,json} at start (root agent shares the bind-mounted logs dir), and wipe stale/fake target/debug/deps/builder-* before the rebuild so the suite run only executes the freshly built binary.
